name: Glance Finance Limited
about: Glance Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in finance and investment activities in India. It also provides asset leasing services for cars, vending machines, etc., as well as offers related ancillary services. In addition, the company offers asset financing, revenue-based finance, supply chain finance, equity market investing, and structure lending solutions. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
